name: Exterior Siding Repaint Finish Coat
intent: Single finish coat. Listed twice for 2-coat system (QT3+). Spray+back at 350 SF/hr, brush/roll at 100 SF/hr, brush-only at 40 SF/hr (shingle).
doctrine: RP finish rates: spray+back 350 SF/hr, brush/roll 100 SF/hr, brush-only 40 SF/hr (shingle profile requires brush for individual shingle faces). Module listed twice for QT3+ 2-coat system. QT2 gets single coat (module listed once).
